name: modash-api-mcp
description: Creator search, profile reports and brand collaboration history from the Modash API, with per-call credit metering and a session budget. Optional RAW API tools for live, unfiltered platform data.
long_description:
Gives Claude access to the Modash Discovery API: search Instagram, TikTok and YouTube creators by structured filters or by a description of their content, pull full profile reports including audience demographics and credibility, and look up brand collaboration history.

Modash bills per call, and some calls are far more expensive than others, so every paid tool reports what it just spent and how much of your session budget is left. A call that would breach the budget is refused before it is sent rather than reported after the fact.

Without a token it runs against synthetic fixtures, so you can try the tools and read the responses without an account.

api_token.title: Modash API token
api_token.description: From marketer.modash.io/developer. Leave blank to run against synthetic fixtures, which spends nothing and needs no account.

credit_budget.title: Credit budget per session
credit_budget.description: Hard ceiling on Modash credits this server may spend before it starts refusing paid calls. A full profile report costs 1 credit; a search costs 0.15.

enable_raw.title: Enable RAW API tools
enable_raw.description: The RAW API is a separate Modash product from Discovery, metered in requests rather than credits. Leave this off unless your plan includes it; the six RAW tools will answer feature_not_available otherwise.

raw_budget.title: RAW request budget per session
raw_budget.description: Hard ceiling on RAW requests before the server starts refusing them. RAW bills failed requests too, so this counts attempts.

tools.name: modash_get_account
tools.description: Account credit balance, rate limits, and the session ledger. Free.

tools.name: modash_find_creator
tools.description: Resolve a handle or name to a Modash userId. Free.

tools.name: modash_lookup_dictionary
tools.description: Look up the location, interest, brand and language ids that search filters require. Free.

tools.name: modash_lookup_ai_dictionary
tools.description: Look up brand, hashtag and mention values for AI Search filters. Free.

tools.name: modash_search_creators
tools.description: Search creators by structured filters on the creator and their audience. 0.15 credits.

tools.name: modash_ai_search_creators
tools.description: Find creators from a natural-language description of their content. 0.025 credits per result.

tools.name: modash_find_lookalikes
tools.description: Find creators similar to ones you already know, across platforms. 0.025 credits per result.

tools.name: modash_get_creator_report
tools.description: Full analysis of one creator: engagement, audience demographics, credibility, sponsored performance. 1 credit.

tools.name: modash_compare_audience_overlap
tools.description: How much several creators' audiences overlap. 1 credit.

tools.name: modash_list_collaborations
tools.description: Individual brand-sponsored posts with stats and disclosure type. 0.2 credits.

tools.name: modash_summarise_collaborations
tools.description: Aggregate partnership history for a creator or brand. 0.2 credits.

tools.name: modash_find_creators_by_email
tools.description: Reverse lookup: find the accounts behind a list of email addresses. 0.02 credits per match.

tools.name: modash_raw_get_profile
tools.description: Live, unfiltered profile straight from the platform. 1 RAW request.

tools.name: modash_raw_list_posts
tools.description: A creator's posts, reels, shorts, streams or tagged posts, live. 1 RAW request per page.

tools.name: modash_raw_get_post
tools.description: One post with its current engagement counts. 1 RAW request.

tools.name: modash_raw_list_comments
tools.description: Comments on a post, or replies to one comment. 1 RAW request per page.

tools.name: modash_raw_search
tools.description: The platform's own creator or hashtag search, unranked by Modash. 1 RAW request.

tools.name: modash_raw_browse
tools.description: Posts under a hashtag, a sound, or a YouTube playlist. 1 RAW request per page.
